yrRZnkmro-IvH_OmZ3f-5A.name: Dragon Slayer

current.QuestObjective: Return to the Wise old man after killing velgar

yrRZnkmro-IvH_OmZ3f-5A.rewards: Tome of Construction Vol 1 (antlers step). DS reward pack Beat2 (3 clay, redberries, harralander) after following Cathan into Ghornfell. DS reward pack Beat5 (Tome of the Dragon Slayer, noxious draconic visage, anti-dragon shield) at the end. Challenge horn recipe from Cathan's ghost.

steps.title: Build shelter, claim a bed
steps.wiki_text: Build a shelter with a bed roll, claim it, then talk to the Wise Old Man.

save_vars.QuestObjective: Claim a bed / Return to the Wise old man after claimed bed

steps.title: Hunt a deer for antlers
steps.wiki_text: The WOM casts a locator spell with the antlers. It points to the castle.

steps.title: Investigate the castle (Keep of Blue Flames)
steps.wiki_text: Read Cathan's journal at the top of the keep. It points to the blue-flame door.

steps.title: Find Cathan in the vault, report to the WOM, go into Ghornfell
steps.wiki_text: Vertentis Kara vault and Spitfoot, back to the WOM, then Ghornfell.

save_vars.QuestObjective: Locate cathan in the vault / Return to the Wise old man / Venture into Ghornfell

steps.title: Cathan's ghost at Velgar's Rise, then craft the challenge horn
steps.wiki_text: The ghost gives the challenge horn recipe: dragon tooth, bloodwood sap and 5 bronze bars.

save_vars.QuestObjective: Look for evidence of Cathan at the tower / Craft the summon horn

steps.title: Challenge and defeat Velgar
steps.wiki_text: Place the horn on the dragonkin altar atop Velgar's Rise.

steps.title: Return to the Wise Old Man with Velgar's head
steps.wiki_text: Hand in the head to complete the quest.

save_vars.QuestObjective: Return to the Wise old man after killing velgar

uftGB0es-CGrvXyPoxW31w.name: Withering Heights
uftGB0es-CGrvXyPoxW31w.rewards: Withering Heights reward pack (Tome of the Undying, undead draconic visage, dragoncurse shield) and the dragoncurse shield masterwork recipe.

steps.title: WOM, enter Fellhollow, search the structure, Postie Pete, unlock the gate
steps.wiki_text: Objectives TalkToWomNEGF, SearchTheStructure, SpeakToPostiePete, GoThroughDoorToFH, UnlockGate.

steps.title: Find a cleansing pool
steps.wiki_text: Objective FindACleansingPool.

steps.title: Investigate the standing stones
steps.wiki_text: Objective InvestigateStandingStones.

steps.title: Break the three seals, challenge Imaru
steps.wiki_text: Objectives BreakTheThreeSeals, BreakRemainingtwoSeals, BreakTheFinalSeal, ChallangeImaru.

steps.title: Return to Death
steps.wiki_text: Objective ReturnToDeath. The quest completes and Death then gives Black Knight's Fortress.

3MpWS0mD8A6yFVmjVAA2Qg.name: Black Knight's Fortress
3MpWS0mD8A6yFVmjVAA2Qg.rewards: Black Knight's Fortress reward pack (Tome of the Titan, Titan's Wrath) and recipe RECIPE_Masterworks_Weapon_GreatSword_TitansWrath (PzF6r0v9aps3QVSoWKGy0A). Completing it auto-starts Icthlarin's Little Helper.

steps.title: Speak to Death
steps.wiki_text: Death in the Forgotten Temple gives the quest after Withering Heights.

steps.title: Speak to Cathan at the eastern gates
steps.wiki_text: Cathan is near the ominous gatehouse south of Silverthorn Keep.
steps.objective_text: Speak to Cathan at the eastern gates in Fellhollow

steps.title: Speak to the Wise Old Man in Dowdun Reach
steps.wiki_text: Go through the ominous door and The Approach to The Courtyard.
steps.objective_text: Speak to the Wise Old Man In Dowdun Reach

steps.title: Speak to Doric in the Nexus
steps.wiki_text: The WOM says Doric is working on the barrier in the Nexus and suggests a base camp.
steps.objective_text: Speak to Doric in Dowdun Reach

steps.title: Investigate the Dreaming Stone
steps.wiki_text: Doric points at the broken stone. Inspecting it starts the shard hunt.

steps.title: Collect the 13 Shards of the Dreaming Stone
steps.wiki_text: 13 shards across Dowdun Reach: Cathedral, Garrison x2, Grand Hall (Spittletoe), Library x2 (Valerius), Menagerie x2, Pastures x2, Crypt, Demon Gate, Lake (Offalfoot).
steps.objective_text: Collect the Shards of the Dreaming Stone around Dowdun Reach: k/13

steps.title: Return to the Dreaming Stone (13/13)
steps.wiki_text: With all 13 found, go back to the stone.

steps.title: Defeat the Gatekeeper (Black Knight Titan)
steps.wiki_text: Avisk takes the 13 shards and drops the barrier. Go to The Bastion and kill the Titan.

save_vars.CanEnterBastion: set true the first time the Bastion barrier is used

steps.note: CURRENT POSITION. CanEnterBastion is absent, so the Bastion barrier has never been used.

steps.title: Return to the Dreaming Stone
steps.wiki_text: The Titan is dead and drops Broken Titan's Wrath.

steps.title: Quest complete
steps.wiki_text: Talk to Avisk while holding Broken Titan's Wrath to get the reward pack and the Titan's Wrath recipe. CompleteQuest runs and ILH starts.

kPtTW0exXrqw2BqELR_bFA.name: Icthlarin's Little Helper

steps.wiki_text: EnterUmS / LookForLife

steps.title: Speak to Icthlarin
steps.wiki_text: SpeakToIcthlarin

steps.title: Earn Moon Garou reputation (tasks), find keys
steps.wiki_text: FirstGarouEarnReputation.*, FindThreeKeys, FindLastKey

steps.title: Repair the mirrors, fight Fuzan
steps.wiki_text: RepairTheMirrors, ReturnToIcthlarin, FightFuzan

steps.title: Speak to the Garou elder, complete
steps.wiki_text: SpeakToGarouElder, then CompleteQuest

user_position.summary: Black Knight's Fortress at QuestBeat 3: the Dreaming Stone is repaired and the barrier is open, but the Gatekeeper (Black Knight Titan) is not defeated yet.

back_2.note: Fragment_1..13 and Fragments_All stay true, so the shard hunt is not replayed. The first stone talk sets QuestBeat 2; the next talk does the 13-shard repair.

back_2_alt_full_shard_hunt.note: Not recommended. World-side shard sources (slain shardbound demons, Sergeant Blister, vines, levers, the library door, the crypt grave) may not respawn. NPC bools (FishingGoblinShardGiven, PlayerGivenFragment_Chef, PlayerGivenFragmentMage, TakenGlassOwl, Library_*) would also need resetting.
